chunks: And through his chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), he said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Whoever deceives the Muslims in a consultation, I am free of him.

key_terms.بَرِئْتُ مِنْهُ: I am free of him / I disassociate from him
key_terms.غَشَّ: To deceive, cheat, or practice fraud

ai.seo_question: What is the consequence for a Muslim who deceives others during consultation?
ai.summary: This hadith, recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, underscores the spiritual gravity of *shura* (consultation) by linking the integrity of counsel directly to the Prophet’s personal association. It serves as a foundational principle in Shia jurisprudence for evaluating the validity of advice given in communal or administrative matters, warning that deceit in this context severs the bond of spiritual kinship.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-297 According to the same documentation, on the authority of Ali (a.s.)
the Prophet (S) said, “I despise whoever cheats Muslims when they seek his counsel.”
